# Instructional Technology Lesson Plan and Hardware Setup
Clearwater Elementary School - Grade 4 Science

## Overview
Instructor: Colleen Ferreira
Unit: Earth Systems and Weather Patterns
Date: 10/14/2026
Room: 204
Support Staff: Grace Hollis (Media Specialist), Teresa Larkin (Instructional Aide)

## Technology Inventory
| Equipment Type | Assigned Units | Connection Standard | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Student Chromebooks | 24 | Wi-Fi 6 (Clearwater-Internal) | Fully charged |
| Interactive Flat Panel | 1 | HDMI 2.1 / USB-C Touch | Calibrated |
| Document Camera | 1 | USB 3.0 to Teacher PC | Operational |
| Audio Soundbar | 1 | 3.5 mm Aux to Panel | Tested at 45 dB |
| VR Headsets | 6 | Standalone Wi-Fi | Staged for Station 3 |

## Presentation and Activity Procedure
- 09:00 AM - Whole-group direct instruction using interactive flat panel to model barometric pressure changes.
- 09:15 AM - Connect document camera to teacher workstation to demonstrate physical barometer readings under pressure chamber.
- 09:30 AM - Small-group rotations across four stations (6 students per group).
- Station 1: Simulation software on Chromebooks analyzing regional weather maps.
- Station 2: Hands-on measurement with analog instruments led by Teresa Larkin.
- Station 3: Immersive virtual storm-tracking observation utilizing the 6 VR headsets.
- Station 4: Collaborative weather journal logging on the interactive panel.

## Hardware Guidelines and Digital Safety
- Confirm all 24 student Chromebooks are logged into managed accounts without filtering.
- Audio levels during whole-class media playback must remain below 70 dB to avoid room spillover.
- Grace Hollis will inspect the interactive flat panel connection via DisplayPort before morning circle.
- Disconnect power cords from floor pathways immediately after station rotations conclude to prevent tripping hazards.

errors.explanation: CIPA (Children's Internet Protection Act) compliance and standard school safety protocols require active content filtering on school-issued student accounts and devices; disabling or omitting content filtering violates federal compliance and district safety standards.
errors.fix: managed accounts with active CIPA web filtering.

errors.quote: interactive flat panel connection via DisplayPort before morning circle.
errors.explanation: The technology inventory table states that the interactive flat panel uses an HDMI 2.1 / USB-C Touch connection standard, contradicting the instruction to inspect a DisplayPort connection.
errors.fix: interactive flat panel connection via HDMI 2.1 before morning circle.
